title: AuditTapRecord v1 — the audit tap's judgement of one act: an enable, a disable, or one observed event, accepted or refused by named reason and counted apart — consent_missing, already_on, operator_missing, not_on, tap_off, type_filtered, malformed_event; events_retained is the feed's size after the act, so an enable or disable record always stands in the record even though it carries no event — the tap's own switching can never be hidden from its record (Y-071)
